name: kann-workflows
description: A product-facing Codex lead with on-demand research, prototype, and delivery workspaces, bundled with credited upstream Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Build products through one natural-language project lead.
interface.longDescription: Starts with one pinned product lead, then opens specifically named research, prototype, diagnosis, review, or delivery tasks only when the work needs a fresh context. Bundled Matt Pocock Skills keep their original invocation split, and Ponytail keeps its lifecycle behavior.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn this product idea into a working first version.
Research an external question that could change this product decision.
Build a small prototype to test this product experience.
Continue this project from its current state.
